personal.name: Eric Garcia
personal.title: Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect
personal.summary: A results-oriented Senior Software Engineer and Systems Architect with over 11 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling cross-platform design systems and cloud-native enterprise architectures. Deeply experienced in bridging the gap between design and engineering, maintaining open-source software, and driving the adoption of accessible (a11y) component libraries. Proficient in React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, and Go, with a track record of leading critical migrations and architecting high-performance UI systems for over 7,000+ active users.

bullets: **Mobile Design System**: Architected and built a custom multi-platform mobile design system from the ground up, starting from a foundation of shadcn/ui and `reactnative-reusables`, customized for brand identity and developer ergonomics.

**Design-to-Code Handoff**: Bridged the product development lifecycle by establishing the mobile design system portfolio while continuously enhancing the desktop library, accelerating velocity across engineering and product teams.
**Enterprise Scale**: Scaled application architecture and component systems to serve 7,000+ active internal users, supporting staff from field engineers to leadership.
**AI Enablement**: Designed and delivered an AI-powered feedback sanitization engine to process and validate downstream customer and reseller messages.
**Technical Roadmaps**: Acted as primary engineering lead on large-scale features, defining development scope, scoping architectures, and conducting reviews.

**Microservices & API Architecture**: Led the development and maintenance of core sales deal microservices (Go, React, TypeScript) on the Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform, driving database performance improvements and legacy system modernizations.

**Security Engineering**: Triaged and resolved critical high-priority security vulnerabilities (e.g. logging and watcher leaks of config keys and API secrets), executing production hotfixes within a strict 24-hour turnaround.
**CI/CD & Developer Experience**: Streamlined pipeline integrations, enhanced testing tooling, and promoted code quality standards (such as untyped Go constants) during developer chapter calls.

**Open-Source Design Systems (Extra Initiative)**: Core maintainer of the IBM Carbon Design System's `gatsby-theme-carbon` project, leading Gatsby major upgrades, fixing theme bugs, and maintaining strict WCAG/a11y compatibility for hundreds of global portals.
**Go Migration Utility**: Built, architected, and expanded a CLI-based migration tool written in Go to transition enterprise client data seamlessly between major versions of IBM API Connect.
**Internationalization**: Spearheaded architectural changes to translate and globalize the CLI tool, addressing client specifications directly.
**Enterprise Analytics**: Developed telemetry, analytics, and enterprise data integration endpoints for a cloud-native API management portal.
**Collaboration**: Partnered across design and engineering silos to preserve component stability and ensure performance under high workloads.
**Level 3 Support**: Audited customer codebases, diagnosed runtime bugs, and deployed core software patches to MobileFirst foundation modules.
**Technical Content**: Created end-to-end integration push notification samples and developer guides in Swift, Java, and Objective-C.
Specialized in Android and iOS mobile application development, assisting in the enhancement of existing applications and the development of new applications.
Updated and improved the UI/UX of an existing native iOS application.
Ensured patient demographics and account details were accurate and appropriate for billing and processing.
Provided clear, thorough financial assessments and obtained necessary insurance authorizations or pre-certifications.
Maintained cooperative, productive relationships among team members and patients through clear communication and problem-solving.
Performed component setup and basic digital programming on advanced welding equipment controls.
Set up parts and major components from blueprints and drawings using precision cutting and abrasive devices.
Conducted detailed surface inspections and quality assurance checks using non-destructive testing (red-dye penetrant).
Set up and adjusted machinery to regulate temperature, pressure, and flow rates for custom structural fabrications.
Assembled and welded high-quality aluminum and steel structures (walls, roofs, cabinets) according to detailed blueprints.
Maintained digital logs of instrument readings, test results, and shift output to ensure regulatory and safety compliance.
